name: Writes a spec with a change list per sub-task

item_template.title: Add a per-project CSV export
item_template.description: Owners want the current report view as a CSV. The sub-tasks for this are already created.
item_template.acceptance_criteria: Given a report with rows, when Export is clicked, then a CSV downloads with every visible row.

judge_criteria: The summary names the spec file it wrote and where it put it.
The summary says every acceptance criterion has at least one test scenario.

notes: Asserts the artefact exists and is complete rather than that it reads well. A spec whose scenarios do not cover every criterion sends the Coder off with a gap nobody agreed to.

name: Asks when there is nothing to spec
notes: Asserts it ends asked_question on a Task with no sub-tasks and no criteria. A done here means it specced work nobody described.

name: Specs without implementing

item_template.title: Cache the reports query
item_template.description: The reports query is slow on repeat views. Specify a cache.
item_template.acceptance_criteria: Given the same report twice, when it is requested again, then the second request is served without re-querying.

notes: Asserts the source tree is untouched. An Architect that writes the code removes the review step the spec exists to enable, and the Coder then reviews its own design.
